subject.title: Require Codex scan artifact coverage proof

question: Should ClawHub enforce `artifact_coverage` as a fail-closed requirement before storing benign Codex worker results as clean?
rationale: The change tightens an authoritative scan trust boundary but can make existing benign worker/model outputs fail until the new contract is accepted and operated.

options.title: Accept after repair
options.body: Land the stricter gate after the zero-byte verifier fix, focused regression coverage, and conflict resolution are complete.

options.title: Stage as diagnostics first
options.body: Collect coverage proof without fail-closing clean storage until operators have more confidence in model output compliance.

options.title: Pause the contract change
options.body: Keep this draft paused or close it in favor of a narrower security-design item if maintainers are not ready to enforce the new output shape.

recommendation.title: Accept after repair
recommendation.body: Land the stricter gate after the zero-byte verifier fix, focused regression coverage, and conflict resolution are complete.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the Codex-backed ClawScan classification path that this PR makes stricter.
